notes: Corrected: both παραλυτικός units now head on *palsy* rather than *sick*. Rule 66's compound clause is explicit that the core word takes the head even where English syntax makes the modifier the formal head and puts the core in a complement (*persuasiveness of speech* on *speech*), and *sick* glosses no part of παραλυτ-.
Edges are unchanged throughout; only the two target heads moved.
